principle: Keep personal data no longer than the purpose needs (Kenya DPA s.39, teaching mapping; legal review pending). Periods below are proposals for sign-off by the DPO, not legal advice.
job: python -m dpa.retention_sweeper (role ops, action retention.sweep). Proposed schedule: daily at 02:00 EAT as a Kubernetes CronJob / Azure Container Apps job. Every run appends to dpa/deletion_records.jsonl, including runs that delete nothing.

triage_messages.why: Long enough for a clinical QA review cycle and for a household to ask what was recorded; message text is the most sensitive data we hold

audit_logs.why: Security investigations and access requests can look back a year; lines hold no message text

api_logs.why: Operational debugging and cost tracking only

tool_metrics.why: Aggregated counts with no actor; not personal data. Documented, not swept by the stub: DELETE FROM calls WHERE ts < now - 180 days.

deletion_records.why: Proof that deletion happened. Holds hashed record ids and counts only. The sweeper refuses to touch it.
